description_en: Queries one or more data sources bound to a policy, or queries one or more policies bound to a data source
description_zh: 查询策略绑定的一个或多个数据源、查询数据源绑定的一个或多个策略
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-policy-bindings --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a --max-results 10 --policy-id po-000000000000000hky --data-source-ids i-uf600000000000068n --source-type UDM_ECS --filters '[{"Operator":"IN","Values":["UDM_ECS"],"Key":"DataSourceType"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePolicyBindings

parameters.help_en: The token required to obtain the next page of policy-data source associations
parameters.help_zh: 获取下一页策略与数据源关联所需的Token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The list of data source IDs
parameters.name: data_source_ids

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
UDM_ECS: ECS instance backup.
OSS: OSS backup.
NAS: Alibaba Cloud NAS backup.
COMMON_NAS: On-premises NAS backup.
ECS_FILE: ECS File Backup Essential Edition.
File: On-premises file backup.
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: CPFS backup.
OTS: Tablestore backup
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
UDM_ECS：表示ECS整机备份。
OSS：表示OSS备份。
NAS：表示阿里云NAS备份。
COMMON_NAS：表示本地NAS备份。
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件备份标准版。
File：表示本地文件备份。
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：表示CPFS备份。
OTS: 表示Tablestore备份
parameters.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The key in the query filter. Valid values:

PolicyId: backup policy ID
DataSourceId: ECS instance ID
DataSourceType: data source type
fields.help_zh:
查询过滤器中的键值。取值包括：

PolicyId：备份策略ID
DataSourceId：ECS实例ID
DataSourceType：数据源类型
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The matching method. Default value: IN. The matching operation (Operator) supported by the Key and Value in the filter. Valid values:

EQUAL: equal to
NOT_EQUAL: not equal to
GREATER_THAN: greater than
GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL: greater than or equal to
LESS_THAN: less than
LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL: less than or equal to
BETWEEN: range. The value is a JSON array `[lower bound, upper bound]`.
IN: in a set. The value is an array
fields.help_zh:
匹配方式。默认为IN。即过滤器中Key和Value支持的匹配操作（Operator）方式，取值包括：

EQUAL：等于
NOT_EQUAL：不等于
GREATER_THAN：大于
GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL：大于等于
LESS_THAN：小于
LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL：小于等于
BETWEEN：区间，value为JSON数组`[下届,上届]`。
IN：在集合中，value为数组
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en: The values to match in the query filter
fields.help_zh: 查询过滤器中的待匹配的值
fields.name: values

MaxResults.description_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：10

Message.description_en: The returned message. "successful" is returned for success. An error message is returned for failure
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

NextToken.description_en: The token required to obtain the next page of policy-data source bindings
NextToken.description_zh: 获取下一页策略与数据源绑定所需的Token

items.description_en: The details of a policy binding

CommonFileSystemDetail.description_en: The advanced options for large-scale file system backup
CommonFileSystemDetail.description_zh: 大规模文件系统备份高级选项

FetchSliceSize.description_en: The sub-task slice size (number of files)

FullOnIncrementFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to switch to a full backup when an incremental backup fails. Valid values:
true: Switches to a full backup upon failure.
false: Does not switch to a full backup upon failure
FullOnIncrementFail.description_zh:
增量备份失败时是否转为全量备份。取值：
true：失败时转为全量备份。
false：失败时不转为全量备份

CommonNasDetail.description_en: The advanced options for on-premises NAS

FetchSliceSize.description_en: The sub-task slice size (number of files)

FullOnIncrementFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to switch to a full backup when an incremental backup fails. Valid values:
true: Switches to a full backup upon failure.
false: Does not switch to a full backup upon failure
FullOnIncrementFail.description_zh:
增量备份失败时是否转为全量备份。取值：
true：失败时转为全量备份。
false：失败时不转为全量备份

FileDetail.description_en: The advanced options for file backup

AdvPolicy.description_en:
Specifies whether to use an advanced policy. Valid values:
true: Used.
false: Not used
AdvPolicy.description_zh:
是否使用高级策略。取值：
true：使用。
false：不适用

UseVSS.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) feature (Windows). Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
UseVSS.description_zh:
是否启用VSS（Windows）功能。取值：
true：启用。
false：不启用

OssDetail.description_en: The advanced options for OSS backup

IgnoreArchiveObject.description_en: Specifies whether to exclude archive objects from task statistics and failed file lists
IgnoreArchiveObject.description_zh: 不在任务统计和失败文件列表中提示归档型对象
IgnoreArchiveObject.title_en: 不在任务统计和失败文件列表中提示归档型对象
IgnoreArchiveObject.title_zh: 不在任务统计和失败文件列表中提示归档型对象

InventoryCleanupPolicy.description_en:
Specifies whether to delete inventory files after backup. This parameter is valid only when OSS inventory is used. Valid values:
NO_CLEANUP: Do not delete.
DELETE_CURRENT: Delete the current file.
DELETE_CURRENT_AND_PREVIOUS: Delete all files
InventoryCleanupPolicy.description_zh:
备份后是否删除清单文件。仅当使用OSS清单时有效。支持：
NO_CLEANUP：不删除。
DELETE_CURRENT：删除当前文件。
DELETE_CURRENT_AND_PREVIOUS：删除所有文件

InventoryId.description_en:
The OSS inventory name. If this value is not empty, the OSS inventory is used for performance tuning.
Using an inventory to improve incremental performance is recommended when backing up more than 100 million OSS objects. Storage fees generated by inventory files are charged separately by OSS.
OSS inventory files take time to generate. Backup may fail before the OSS inventory file is generated. Wait for the next cycle to execute
InventoryId.description_zh:
OSS清单名称，该值不为空时将使用OSS清单用于性能调优。
建议备份1亿以上OSS对象采用清单提升增量性能，由清单文件产生的存储费用由OSS服务单独收取。
OSS清单文件生成需要时间，在OSS清单文件生成完成之前可能会备份失败，可以等待下个周期执行

UdmDetail.description_en: The advanced options for ECS instance backup

AppConsistent.description_en: Specifies whether to create an application-consistent snapshot. Creating an application-consistent snapshot is supported only when all cloud disk types are ESSD
AppConsistent.description_zh: 是否创建应用一致性。仅云盘类型全部为ESSD时，支持创建快照应用一致性

DestinationKmsKeyId.description_en: The custom KMS key ID in the destination region. If this field is not empty and cross-region replication is enabled, this key is used to encrypt the cross-region replication
DestinationKmsKeyId.description_zh: 目标地域自定义KMS密钥ID，该字段不为空且开启异地复制时，将使用该密钥进行加密异地复制

DiskIdList.description_en: The list of cloud disk IDs that need to be protected. This value is empty when all cloud disks are protected
DiskIdList.description_zh: 需要保护的云盘ID列表。保护所有云盘时，该值为空

items.description_en: The cloud disk ID that needs to be protected

EnableFsFreeze.description_en: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. Specifies whether to use the Linux FsFreeze mechanism to ensure the file system is in read consistency before creating an application-consistent snapshot. Default value: true
EnableFsFreeze.description_zh: 仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。是否在创建应用一致性快照前使用Linux的FsFreeze机制确保文件系统处于只读一致性。默认为true

EnableWriters.description_en:
This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. Specifies whether to create an application-consistent snapshot:
true: Creates an application-consistent snapshot.
false: Creates a file system-consistent snapshot.

Default value: true
EnableWriters.description_zh:
仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。是否设置应用一致性快照：
true：创建应用一致性快照
false：创建文件系统一致性快照

默认为true

ExcludeDiskIdList.description_en: The list of cloud disk IDs that do not need to be protected. This parameter is ignored when DiskIdList is not empty
ExcludeDiskIdList.description_zh: 不需要保护的云盘ID列表。当DiskIdList不为空时，将忽略该参数

items.description_en: The cloud disk ID that does not need to be protected

PostScriptPath.description_en: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. The path of the post-thaw script to execute after creating an application-consistent snapshot
PostScriptPath.description_zh: 仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。创建应用一致性快照后执行的解冻脚本路径

PreScriptPath.description_en: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. The path of the pre-freeze script to execute before creating an application-consistent snapshot
PreScriptPath.description_zh: 仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。创建应用一致性快照前执行的冻结脚本路径

RamRoleName.description_en: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. The RAM role name required for creating application-consistent snapshots
RamRoleName.description_zh: 仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。创建应用一致性快照需要配置的RAM角色名称

SnapshotGroup.description_en: Specifies whether to create a snapshot-consistent group. Creating a snapshot-consistent group is supported only when all cloud disk types are ESSD
SnapshotGroup.description_zh: 是否创建快照一致性组。仅云盘类型全部为ESSD时，支持创建快照一致性组

TimeoutInSeconds.description_en: This parameter is required only when AppConsistent is set to true. The I/O freeze timeout period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 30
TimeoutInSeconds.description_zh: 仅当AppConsistent为true时，需要配置该参数。IO冻结超时时间。单位为秒，默认为30秒

CreatedByTag.description_en: Indicates whether the resource is automatically associated through a backup policy resource tag
CreatedByTag.description_zh: 资源是否通过备份策略资源标签自动关联

CreatedTime.description_en: The creation time. UNIX timestamp, in seconds

CrossAccountRoleName.description_en: The RAM role name created in the source account for cross-account backup
CrossAccountRoleName.description_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名

CrossAccountType.description_en:
The cross-account backup type. Valid values: 
SELF_ACCOUNT: backup within the current account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: cross-account backup
CrossAccountType.description_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份

CrossAccountUserId.description_en: The ID of the source account for cross-account backup

Disabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the policy is effective for the data source.
true: paused.
false: not paused
Disabled.description_zh:
策略是否对该数据源生效。
true：暂停
false：未暂停

Exclude.description_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE or File. Specifies the file types to exclude from backup. All files of these types are not backed up. Maximum of 255 characters
Exclude.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE或File时，需要配置该参数。表示不需要进行备份的文件类型，该类型的所有文件都不备份。最多支持255个字符

Operator.description_en:
The tag matching rule.
EQUAL: Matches both the tag key and tag value.
NOT: Matches the tag key but does not match the tag value
Operator.description_zh:
标签匹配规则。
EQUAL：匹配标签键和标签值。
NOT：匹配标签键，不匹配标签值

Include.description_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE or File. Specifies the file types to back up. All files of these types are backed up. Maximum of 255 characters
Include.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE或File时，需要配置该参数。表示要进行备份的文件类型，这些类型的所有文件都备份。最多支持255个字符

PolicyBindingDescription.description_en: The description of the policy binding

Source.description_en:
If SourceType is set to OSS, this parameter specifies the prefix to back up. If not specified, the entire Bucket root directory is backed up.
If SourceType is set to ECS_FILE or File, this parameter specifies the file directory to back up. If not specified, all directories are backed up
Source.description_zh:
当SourceType取值为OSS时，表示备份某个prefix，如果不指定，则表示备份整个Bucket根目录。
当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE或File时，表示备份的文件目录，如果不指定，则表示备份全部目录

SourceType.description_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
UDM_ECS: ECS instance backup.
OSS: OSS backup.
NAS: Alibaba Cloud NAS backup.
COMMON_NAS: On-premises NAS backup.
ECS_FILE: ECS File Backup Essential Edition.
File: On-premises file backup.
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: CPFS backup.
OTS: Tablestore backup
SourceType.description_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
UDM_ECS：表示ECS整机备份。
OSS：表示OSS备份。
NAS：表示阿里云NAS备份。
COMMON_NAS：表示本地NAS备份。
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件备份标准版。
File：表示本地文件备份。
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：表示CPFS备份。
OTS: 表示Tablestore备份

SpeedLimit.description_en:
This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE or File. Specifies the backup traffic control. Format: `{start}{end}{bandwidth}`. Multiple traffic control configurations are separated by delimiters, and configuration times cannot overlap.

start: start hour.
end: end hour.
bandwidth: rate limit, in KB/s
SpeedLimit.description_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE或File时，需要配置该参数。表示备份流量控制。格式为`{start}{end}{bandwidth}`。多个流量控制配置使用分隔，并且配置时间不允许有重叠。

start：起始小时。
end：结束小时。
bandwidth：限制速率，单位KB/s

UpdatedTime.description_en: The update time. UNIX timestamp, in seconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 更新时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
